overview.headline: Review 65 providers in this cycle's queue, built from rule checks and risk ranking.
overview.summary: This cycle's queue has 65 providers. Rule checks found 15 providers with clear billing errors, and risk ranking added 50 more. Out of 1082 providers ranked, 1017 are outside the queue.

actions.why: 53 providers are recommended for a full audit, and 47 of these look unusual beyond their size.
12 providers are recommended for a desk review, with 4 of these being borderline cases for you to decide on.

overview.how_to_read: The ranking shows how closely a provider's billing matches providers flagged in the past. Higher ranks mean stronger similarities, but it only highlights patterns and never proves wrongdoing.
watch_out_for: Check for duplicate claims and overlapping hospital stays in the rule checks.
Look closely at the 4 borderline desk reviews before deciding on a full audit.

caveats.text: Past flags mean previously suspected, not proven fraud.
Large legitimate providers may rank high simply due to their size.
How past flags were assigned is undocumented.
This uses public, probably synthetic 2008-2009 data as a demonstration.
A person decides; the ranking never denies or delays a payment.
